captures.name: simple_session
captures.command: claude -p --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages --verbose "Print exactly one short sentence. Do not call any tools."
captures.notes: Captured inside an existing Claude Code session; 'system.hook_response' line includes parent-session hook context (large embedded JSON string). The model's reply ("Acknowledged—standing by for your next instruction.") is influenced by parent context but parser correctness is independent of content.

captures.name: error_session
captures.notes: Error path. assistant event carries top-level error:"invalid_request"; result event has is_error:true and api_error_status:404, but subtype is still "success" (consider this an upstream quirk).
